metadata.latency_definition: Per-frame warmed CPU wall time at the common candidate threshold of 0.01. Includes detector preprocessing and postprocessing, excluding image decoding, model loading, and the final confidence cutoff. V3 sums the measured V1, V2, and fusion times. V4 adds its score adjustment time.

v0.description: Proposal's full-frame detector at its original operating point

proposal.description: Proposal's gameplay ROI and geometry filters, before tracking

v1_roi.description: Higher-resolution inference in the proposal's gameplay ROI with the same filters

v2.description: Four overlapping tiles, with internal-edge rejection and greedy NMS

v3.description: V1 plus V2 with confidence-weighted cross-scale box fusion and greedy NMS

v4.description: Diagnostic: V3 plus score suppression using the proposal's geometry rules
